beats.headline: A different game completely
beats.text: Mordecai, in the tutorial, on how the show is run. Different corporations take turns with the seasons, one every two and a quarter years or so, and each one runs its own kind of game. The Squim Conglomerate, for example, chooses a different game completely: a battle royale-style fight. An entire world, and it all comes down to one champion. It is good for ratings, but from what he understands, it does not make them much money. His own company is known for the most elaborate dungeons.

beats.headline: Battle for the Planet Aryl
beats.text: The premiere opens with a recap of last season. A planet like Earth with the continents jumbled; buildings on stilts swept sideways by the collapse; then a coliseum the size of a city, marked The Squim Conglomerate Presents, Battle for the Planet Aryl. Furry, gorilla-like creatures charge one another. One armoured gorilla spears a smaller gray one riding a huge pig, WINNER appears, and the winner falls to his knees, sobbing. Tally's verdict: they tell people their loved ones are safe if they kill. Squim saps the planet dry and moves on. Better dead.

beats.headline: Always plays Battle Royale
beats.text: The Maestro, in the interview on the big screen, explains why he missed Faction Wars last time. He was of age last season, but the stupid Squim Conglomerate always plays Battle Royale, which has no Faction Wars or Celestial Ascendancy segment. This year he means to be there. He is on his way to Carl's stupid planet right now, to be War Leader Maestro of the Skull Clan. He pounds his chest like a gorilla while saying so.

beats.headline: Katia's new sponsor
beats.text: New sponsors arrive for everyone. Donut gets Veriluxx RealPet Companions. Katia gets the Squim Conglomerate, and does not know who that is. Carl does: the corporation that ran the crawl last season, a planet-mining company just like Borant, running battle royale crawls. He does not know what kind of alien they are. Katia finds she can see who else they sponsor. The list has something like five hundred crawlers on it, and she does not recognize any of the names.

beats.headline: No admins lost
beats.text: Orren the liaison, making Carl sit through a lesson on assassinated admins. Two seasons ago, a crocodilian bit the head off his outreach associate, and the Fortent admins lost two security agents on top of that: three dead, which is a lot. Last season, the Squim Conglomerate had no admin fatalities due to crawler attacks at all. Orren asks Carl to guess this season's number. Zero, says Carl. It stands at fifteen, not counting Admin Loita, and Lucia Mar has killed two.

beats.headline: The Aryl system goes dark
beats.text: Zev brings the news, a few hours old. After Princess Formidable was teleported away, her ship carried on to its destination and stopped. When she did not return, a few orcs went into the station and triggered the failsafe themselves. Nothing happened here. But the moment they pressed the button, the Aryl system went dark, tunnel node and all, which has never happened before. Aryl was the previous crawl's world. Where did everyone go? That was a Squim season, Zev says. They do things a little differently. There were some survivors. They were relocated.

beats.headline: Rishi's question about Aryl
beats.text: Rishi, the armless naga, asks Carl from his cell whether Carl knew that the Aryl system went dark the moment Princess Formidable hit the failsafe. Carl corrects him: Formidable never made it to the failsafe. The AI pulled her off her ship and dropped her in the ocean. But yes, he heard, and he knows the last season happened there. Rishi nods, and does not elaborate his point.

beats.headline: Another system, a star gone nova
beats.text: Victory has news for Huanxin: the newest mantis colony system has just gone dark, at the same moment the other rottweiler died a few hours back. The initial reports are a little more holistic than they were in the Aryl system. This time, the star went nova. Huanxin calls her a lying bitch, and adds that, even if she is not, there is insurance.
